entities.name: Roman Emona & Poetovio
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Roman conquest of the Norican and Pannonian territories, the founding of Emona (Ljubljana) and Poetovio (Ptuj) as legionary centres, and the region's role on the empire's Danubian frontier.
